title: Mochizuki Honami — Beyond A Smile〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles

rows.Line: Scent Shop

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, for now, would you all like to browse around here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I need to head over to the crafts shop over there to pick up something I ordered.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, then... Do you want me to come with you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd rather you all take your time and have fun while picking out some oils since they have so many available.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right...
Then, we'll stay here and keep browsing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There we are...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(Things really added up over time, but I'm glad that I finally have everything that I ordered now.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Now, to return to the others...)
Oh, Honami, it's you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Good wonderhoy, Honami☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hi, Emu!
Are you also here to do some shopping?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup♪ It's almost Valentine's Day, so I'm buying all the ingredients for the chocolates I'm gonna make for Tsukasa and everyone!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you're making them yourself?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. And they don't know this yet, but I'm gonna make everyone in chocolate form♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Everyone in chocolate form...?
Oh, are you going to make chocolate figures of them?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa! Honami, that's right!
Ding ding ding! We have a winner☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're also here to shop, right, Honami? Are you getting Valentine's Day stuff?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, with Ichika and Kusa...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (No, wait! I think Kusanagi hasn't told Emu and the others that she's making something for them...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... I-Ichika, her friends and I are here to buy a few things.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You are?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes, that's right!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But you're all alone right now, Honami. Want me to help you carry some of your things?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you, but I'll be okay!
I've become much stronger after playing the drums so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: See? This is... Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The paper cups I just bought...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: W-W-Wah! Got it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry, Emu.
Thank you for catching it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You're welcome♪
I know your hands are literally full, so lemme put it back in its bag for you☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, thank...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (No, wait...! Th-That bag contains...!!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? That's a lot of candles...
Are you guys gonna use them all today?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: U-Umm...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Wh-What do I do?! What should I say...?!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm... Paper cups and candles...
That means...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (D-Did she already figure it out...?!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know! You're getting a birthday party together!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, actually...
Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You've got lots of candles, so it has to be someone's birthday☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's so cool.
I've never seen anyone use so many candles at once before!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which means you're gonna have a super-duper-extra-large cake, right?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoever's birthday it is, I bet they're gonna have such a huge smile on their face when they see a cake like that!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh no...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (As glad as I am that I didn't have to reveal the truth to her, it's like I'm lying to her. I feel awful...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-Thank you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: By the way, do you need any help with anything? I have some time still, so I'll be more than happy to lend you a hand...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Please give me a chance to atone for what just happened...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm looking for chocolate pens in certain colors, but the ones they have at the store are slightly different from what I'm looking for...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I just need them to be a little lighter or a little darker. Do you think I just have to keep looking around at other stores?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In that case, why not mix them like paints? That could help you achieve the colors you're hoping to get.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! You can do that?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. You can use white chocolate to make them lighter and red food coloring to darken them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa...! I didn't know that!
Then, I might be able to get the colors I want♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You really are the best, Honami!
Thanks so much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, I'm gonna go back to the candy place again! I really appreciate it, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course! Please feel free to ask me more questions whenever.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I hope that makes up for what I just did...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Now, I need to get back to the others.
